main.accounts.badTarget.defaultMessage: Hive won't link a connection to {target}: it isn't one of {cli}'s own folders.
main.accounts.badTarget.description: An error adding a connection: the folder a connection's shared folder would link to ({target}, a path) isn't in the coding agent CLI's ({cli}) own folder.

main.accounts.checkHeld.defaultMessage: {name} is being checked: Hive is still making sure {cli}'s check of it has ended. Try again in a moment.
main.accounts.checkHeld.description: An error signing in or removing a connection ({name}, its name in Settings → Accounts & Connections): the coding agent CLI's ({cli}: "Codex") check of who it is signed in as hasn't been confirmed ended yet, so the connection is held.

main.accounts.folderNotUsable.defaultMessage: {name}'s folder isn't the one Hive made (it is missing, or was moved or replaced), so nothing was started on it. Remove the connection and add it again.
main.accounts.folderNotUsable.description: An error signing a connection in or starting on it ({name}, its name): its folder is missing or isn't the one Hive made.

main.accounts.inUse.defaultMessage: {name} is in use: stop the agents on it and close its sign-in, then remove it.
main.accounts.inUse.description: An error removing a connection ({name}, its name in Settings → Accounts & Connections): agents run on it, or its sign-in terminal is open.

main.accounts.keyRemoveFailed.defaultMessage: {name} wasn't removed: its key couldn't be deleted. Nothing was changed; Remove tries again.
main.accounts.keyRemoveFailed.description: An error removing a server connection ({name}, its name in Settings → Accounts & Connections): its stored API key couldn't be deleted, so the connection was left as it was.

main.accounts.leftover.defaultMessage: {name} is half removed: remove it again first.
main.accounts.leftover.description: An error signing a connection in ({name}): an earlier removal stopped partway, so it can't be used.

main.accounts.makeFailed.description: An error adding a connection: its folder or link couldn't be made. {error} is the reason, in English.

main.accounts.noHome.defaultMessage: {cli}'s folder ({folder}) isn't there yet: run {cli} once, then add the connection.
main.accounts.noHome.description: An error adding a connection: the coding agent CLI's ({cli}) own folder ({folder}, a path) doesn't exist on this PC.

main.accounts.noName.description: An error adding or renaming a connection in Settings → Accounts & Connections: its name is empty.

main.accounts.noProvider.defaultMessage: {cli} can't have sign-in connections in Hive yet.
main.accounts.noProvider.description: An error: connections were asked for a coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Codex") that Hive keeps no connections for.

main.accounts.notFound.description: An error: a connection named by its id is not in Settings → Accounts & Connections (removed meanwhile).

main.accounts.nothingToKeep.defaultMessage: {name} isn't signed in as anyone Hive could check, so there's no login to keep.
main.accounts.nothingToKeep.description: An error: Keep the new login was asked for a connection ({name}) whose latest check didn't find it signed in.

main.accounts.removeFailed.defaultMessage: {name} wasn't removed: {error}. Nothing outside its folder was touched; Remove tries again.
main.accounts.removeFailed.description: An error removing a connection ({name}): its folder couldn't all be deleted. {error} is the reason, in English.

main.accounts.running.defaultMessage: {name} has agents running on it: stop them, then remove it.
main.accounts.running.description: An error removing a connection ({name}, its name in Settings → Accounts & Connections): agents run on it, or one is starting.

main.accounts.setUpCancelled.defaultMessage: {name}'s Set Up didn't open: the connection was removed or its workspace closed while Hive checked its folders.
main.accounts.setUpCancelled.description: An error opening a connection's Set Up (Settings → Accounts & Connections, HI-1870; {name}, its name): Hive was checking which of the workspace's folders its coding agent CLI trusts when the connection was removed or the workspace closed, so nothing was started.

main.accounts.usageMove.bad.defaultMessage: Choose a share from 1% to 100%, a limit, and another account of the same CLI to move its agents to.
main.accounts.usageMove.bad.description: An error setting an account's usage move in Settings → Accounts & Connections (HI-2195): the share, the limit or the account to move to isn't one it can be.

main.antivirus.allExcluded.defaultMessage: Every folder Hive may offer is already excluded.
main.antivirus.allExcluded.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning: nothing to add.

main.antivirus.changed.defaultMessage: The workspace changed since you were asked: nothing was changed.
main.antivirus.changed.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning.

main.antivirus.closed.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning.

main.antivirus.foldersChanged.defaultMessage: The folders changed since you were asked: review them again. Nothing was changed.
main.antivirus.foldersChanged.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning.

main.antivirus.noWorkspace.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning.

main.antivirus.noneAdded.defaultMessage: Hive added no exclusions for this workspace.
main.antivirus.noneAdded.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning: nothing to remove.

main.antivirus.notDefender.defaultMessage: Microsoft Defender isn’t the active antivirus here.
main.antivirus.notDefender.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning.

main.antivirus.notWaiting.defaultMessage: That change is no longer waiting: ask again.
main.antivirus.notWaiting.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning: an exclusion change asked for was answered too late or twice.

main.antivirus.other.defaultMessage: Another antivirus is active: Hive can only change Microsoft Defender’s exclusions.
main.antivirus.other.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning. Microsoft Defender is a name.

main.antivirus.timeout.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning: Hive's PowerShell check didn't finish in time.

main.antivirus.tooLong.defaultMessage: That change waited too long for an answer: ask again.
main.antivirus.tooLong.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning.

main.antivirus.unreadable.defaultMessage: Defender's exclusions couldn't be read even with administrator rights, so nothing was changed.
main.antivirus.unreadable.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning.

main.antivirus.windowsOnly.description: An error in Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning on another system.

main.assistantQuestion.answered.description: What the notification of a question from the Hive Assistant says once it is answered or no longer waits (HI-2320), in place of its buttons. Keep it short.

main.assistantQuestion.stop.message.defaultMessage: The Assistant wants to stop {agent}, which is {state}.{hasReason, select, yes { Its reason: {reason}} other {}} Its conversation is kept and can be resumed.
main.assistantQuestion.stop.message.description: Under the question "Stop <agent> in <project>?". {state} is what the agent is doing (main.assistantQuestion.stop.state); {reason} is the Assistant's own reason, as it wrote it, ending with a full stop.

main.assistantQuestion.stop.no.description: The button that answers no to "Stop <agent> in <project>?".

main.assistantQuestion.stop.state.defaultMessage: {status, select, working {working} waiting {waiting for the user} signin {waiting for the user to sign in to its CLI again (its sign-in expired)} starting {starting} background {waiting on background tasks it started} watching {waiting for cards to change (a card watch: its card loop pauses until it is resumed)} ready {idle} finished {idle (finished its task)} error {in error} stopped {stopped} other {{status}}}
main.assistantQuestion.stop.state.description: What an agent is doing, inside "The Assistant wants to stop <agent>, which is …". The other branch is its status as Hive names it in code: keep {status}.

main.assistantQuestion.stop.title.description: A question from the Hive Assistant to the user, in its panel (and a notification while the panel is hidden): it wants to stop an agent that is busy. {agent} is the agent's name, {project} its project's.

main.assistantQuestion.stop.yes.description: The button that answers yes to "Stop <agent> in <project>?" (the Assistant asks before stopping a busy agent).

main.board.damagedBody.defaultMessage: {files} stayed out of the board. They are kept in {folder}.
main.board.damagedBody.description: The notice about card files Hive couldn't read as it moved the board into its database: {files} lists them, {folder} is where they are kept.

main.board.damagedTitle.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# card file couldn't be read} other {# card files couldn't be read}}
main.board.damagedTitle.description: A notice as Hive moved the board's cards into its database: some card files weren't valid. {n} is how many.

main.board.foundBody.defaultMessage: They are kept, unchanged, in {folder}. Nothing on the board was changed for them: Review… adds each to the board or discards it.
main.board.foundBody.description: The notice about cards an older Hive saved: {folder} is the folder where they are kept.

main.board.foundTitle.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# card made by an older Hive was found: review it} other {# cards made by an older Hive were found: review them}}
main.board.foundTitle.description: A notice: this workspace was opened in an older Hive meanwhile, and it saved cards; they weren't added to the board, but kept for the user to review. {n} is how many.

main.board.review.description: A button on the notice about cards an older Hive saved: opens a dialog listing them, to add each to the board or discard it.

main.branchMerge.cardWork.defaultMessage: {branch} is {card}'s work: merge it through its card, or confirm merging it here.
main.branchMerge.cardWork.description: An error merging from the Merge dialog: the branch ({branch}) is the line of a card ({card}: its key) that isn't Done, and the merge wasn't confirmed for that card (the dialog asks first).

main.branchMerge.notBranch.defaultMessage: {branch} is not a local branch of the project.
main.branchMerge.notBranch.description: An error merging from the Merge dialog (#1450): the branch picked ({branch}) isn't one of the repository's local branches (deleted meanwhile, say).

main.branchMerge.same.description: An error merging from the Merge dialog: the branch picked and the target are the same ({branch}).

main.connections.badMode.description: An error saving a connection (HI-2107): the permission mode asked for ({mode}, as given) is not one of the coding agent CLI's ({cli}: "Codex").

main.connections.beingRemoved.description: An error removing a connection (HI-2107): a removal of it ({name}, its name) is already under way.

main.connections.choice.missing.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for {agent} no longer exists. Choose another, or the workspace's default.
main.connections.choice.missing.description: An error saving an agent's settings (or adding one): the connection chosen for it ({agent}, its name) was removed. A connection is how a coding agent CLI signs in or reaches its model (Settings → Accounts & Connections).

main.connections.choice.off.defaultMessage: {name} isn't on in this workspace. Turn it on in Settings → Accounts & Connections, or choose another for {agent}.
main.connections.choice.off.description: An error saving an agent's settings (or adding one): the connection chosen ({name}) is off in this workspace, so it can't be the agent's ({agent}, its name). Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

main.connections.choice.otherCli.defaultMessage: {name} is for another CLI than {agent}'s. Choose one of its own.
main.connections.choice.otherCli.description: An error saving an agent's settings (or adding one): the connection chosen ({name}) belongs to another coding agent CLI than the agent's ({agent}, its name).

main.connections.inUse.defaultMessage: Still in use, so {name} was kept: {users}. Choose another connection for them first, then remove it.
main.connections.inUse.description: An error removing a connection (Settings → Accounts & Connections, HI-2107): agents or the Assistant use it ({users}: their names, listed, each with its project).

main.connections.launch.changedAgain.defaultMessage: {agent}'s connection was changed again while it was starting. Start it again.
main.connections.launch.changedAgain.description: Starting an agent ({agent}, its name) failed: the connection chosen for it was changed while it was starting, and again while Hive started it once more on the new choice. A connection is how a coding agent CLI signs in or reaches its model (Settings → Accounts & Connections).

main.connections.launch.changing.defaultMessage: {name}'s login kept changing while Hive checked it. Try starting {agent} again in a moment.
main.connections.launch.changing.description: Starting an agent ({agent}) is refused: its connection's ({name}) login changed again and again while Hive checked who it is signed in as.

main.connections.launch.deleted.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for {agent} no longer exists. Choose another in its Agent Settings.
main.connections.launch.deleted.description: Starting an agent ({agent}) is refused: the connection chosen for it was removed. Agent Settings names a dialog.

main.connections.launch.noKey.defaultMessage: {name} has no key. Add one in Settings → Accounts & Connections, then start {agent}.
main.connections.launch.noKey.description: Starting an agent ({agent}) is refused: its server account ({name}) reaches a server that needs an API key, and none is saved for it. Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

main.connections.launch.none.defaultMessage: No {cli} account is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Accounts & Connections and sign it in, then start {agent} again.
main.connections.launch.none.description: Starting an agent ({agent}, its name) is refused: its workspace has no account on for its coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code"). Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

main.connections.launch.offNoDefault.defaultMessage: {agent}'s account, {name}, is off in this workspace, and no other {cli} account is on. Turn one on in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
main.connections.launch.offNoDefault.description: Starting an agent ({agent}) is refused: the connection chosen for it ({name}) is off in this workspace and there's no default to use instead. {cli} is the coding agent CLI.

main.connections.launch.otherProvider.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for {agent} is for another CLI. Pick a {cli} connection in its Agent Settings.
main.connections.launch.otherProvider.description: Starting an agent ({agent}) is refused: the connection chosen for it belongs to another coding agent CLI. {cli} is the agent's CLI ("Claude Code").

main.connections.launch.signedOut.defaultMessage: {name} is signed out. Sign it in again in Settings → Accounts & Connections, then start {agent}.
main.connections.launch.signedOut.description: Starting an agent ({agent}) is refused: its account ({name}) isn't signed in.

main.connections.moveFailed.defaultMessage: Hive couldn't move {project}'s model settings to its agents
main.connections.moveFailed.description: A notice's title (HI-1770): moving a project's own model, effort and context settings onto its agents (connections now hold the defaults) failed; it is tried again at the next start. {project} is the project's name.

main.connections.nameTaken.defaultMessage: {account} already has a connection named {name}. Choose another name.
main.connections.nameTaken.description: An error saving a connection (Settings → Accounts & Connections, HI-2107): another connection on the same account ({account}, its name) has this name ({name}).

main.connections.noName.description: An error saving a connection (Settings → Accounts & Connections, HI-2107): its name is empty.

main.connections.notFound.description: An error (HI-2107): a connection named by its id is not in Settings → Accounts & Connections (removed meanwhile).

main.connections.userIn.description: One user of a connection in the error refusing its removal (HI-2107): an agent ({agent}) and its project ({project}).

main.console.noWorkspace.defaultMessage: Open a workspace first: the developer console shows a workspace's agents and Hive's work there.
main.console.noWorkspace.description: An error when the developer console is opened with no workspace open.

main.console.title.description: The developer console's window title. {workspace} is the workspace's folder name.

main.corrupt.damaged.description: A notice: one of Hive's settings or record files couldn't be read. {file} is its name.

main.corrupt.defaultsBody.defaultMessage: Hive had no good copy, so it started from defaults. The damaged file was kept as {aside}.
main.corrupt.defaultsBody.description: The notice about a damaged file Hive had no good copy of. {aside} is where the damaged file was kept.

main.corrupt.restored.defaultMessage: {file} was damaged and has been restored
main.corrupt.restored.description: A notice: one of Hive's settings or record files couldn't be read, and Hive went back to its last good copy. {file} is its name.

main.corrupt.restoredBody.defaultMessage: Hive went back to its last good copy. The damaged file was kept as {aside}.
main.corrupt.restoredBody.description: The notice about a damaged file Hive restored. {aside} is where the damaged file was kept.

main.danger.off.description: A notice after a provider's dangerous permission modes were turned off in Settings. {modes} lists them.

main.danger.offBody.defaultMessage: These projects were switched back to Inherit: {projects}. Running sessions keep their mode until restarted.
main.danger.offBody.description: The notice after dangerous permission modes were turned off: the projects that used one. Inherit is a choice of the project's settings: keep it as Hive shows it.

main.finished.inProject.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# agent finished in {project}} other {# agents finished in {project}}}
main.finished.inProject.description: A notification for several agents of one project that finished together. {n} is how many (2 or more); the agents are listed under it.

main.finished.many.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# agent finished} other {# agents finished}}
main.finished.many.description: A notification for agents of several projects that finished together. {n} is how many (2 or more); the projects are listed under it.

main.finished.project.description: A project in the notification for agents that finished together, with how many of its agents finished.

main.freshStart.action.description: The button of the notification that a project's work has finished (#1437): opens Start Fresh (Idle Agents) for the project, which asks first.

main.freshStart.body.defaultMessage: {project}'s work has finished: its idle agents can start new conversations. The old ones are kept.
main.freshStart.body.description: The body of the notification that a project's work has finished (#1437), above its button Start Fresh (Idle Agents). {project} is the project's name. The old conversations stay in the Sessions tab.

main.freshStart.notFound.description: Start Fresh for one agent is refused: the agent named ({agent}, its id) is not in the project.

main.freshStart.title.defaultMessage: A good moment to start fresh
main.freshStart.title.description: A notification's title (#1437): a project's work has finished (its lane ended, or its card is done, and no agent is busy), so its agents could start fresh conversations, which costs less than carrying on long ones.

main.gitInit.already.defaultMessage: This folder is a git repository already.
main.gitInit.already.description: Why a folder can't be made a git repository again.

main.gitInit.done.defaultMessage: {steps}. .hive stays out of git. Agents can work in worktrees now.
main.gitInit.done.description: What making a git repository did. {steps} lists the steps (main.gitInit.step.*), its first capitalised. .hive is a folder's name.

main.gitInit.failed.commit.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter).

main.gitInit.failed.config.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter). {key} is a git setting (user.name, user.email).

main.gitInit.failed.exclude.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter). .hive is a folder's name.

main.gitInit.failed.gitignore.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter). .gitignore is a file name.

main.gitInit.failed.identity.defaultMessage: {which, select, name {git has no name to make the first commit as here} email {git has no email to make the first commit as here} other {git has no name or email to make the first commit as here}}
main.gitInit.failed.identity.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter): git has no identity to commit as. {which} says what it lacks.

main.gitInit.failed.ignored.defaultMessage: git still doesn't ignore .hive here (a rule in a .gitignore may bring it back), so nothing was committed
main.gitInit.failed.ignored.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter). .hive and .gitignore are names.

main.gitInit.failed.init.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter).

main.gitInit.failed.stage.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter).

main.gitInit.failed.staged.defaultMessage: .hive was staged, so nothing was committed
main.gitInit.failed.staged.description: What failed in making a git repository, a clause (main.gitInit.stoppedAfter). .hive is a folder's name.

main.gitInit.fix.commit.defaultMessage: {git}. Commit in a terminal, or ask an agent to
main.gitInit.fix.commit.description: Why the first commit failed and what to do. {git} is git's own message.

main.gitInit.fix.identity.defaultMessage: {which, select, name {enter it and choose Make first commit} email {enter it and choose Make first commit} other {enter them and choose Make first commit}}
main.gitInit.fix.identity.description: What to do when git has no name or email to commit as (main.gitInit.failed.identity). Make first commit is a button: use its name as shown.

main.gitInit.fix.ignored.defaultMessage: fix that, then choose Make first commit in the Version Control tab
main.gitInit.fix.ignored.description: What to do after .hive was found not ignored by git (main.gitInit.failed.ignored). Make first commit is a button in the Version Control tab (glossary 2.1): use its name as shown.

main.gitInit.fix.staged.defaultMessage: check the .gitignore for a rule that brings .hive back
main.gitInit.fix.staged.description: What to do after .hive was staged (main.gitInit.failed.staged).

main.gitInit.nested.defaultMessage: This folder is inside the git repository in {root}. Confirm that you want a repository of its own inside it.
main.gitInit.nested.description: Why a folder wasn't made a git repository yet: it is inside another one, {root}, and the user didn't confirm a repository of its own.

main.gitInit.noEmail.defaultMessage: Git has no email to make the first commit as: enter one.
main.gitInit.noEmail.description: Why a folder was not made a git repository: no email address to commit as is set, and the user entered none.

main.gitInit.noGit.defaultMessage: {problem}: Provider Setup says how to fix it.
main.gitInit.noGit.description: Why a folder can't be made a git repository (the Initialise Git Repository dialog): git is missing or broken. {problem} says what's wrong. Provider Setup is a view's name.

main.gitInit.noName.defaultMessage: Git has no name to make the first commit as: enter one.
main.gitInit.noName.description: Why a folder was not made a git repository: no name to commit as is set, and the user entered none.

main.gitInit.otherVcs.defaultMessage: {vcs} keeps this folder (in {root}): Hive makes a git repository only where no other version control system is.
main.gitInit.otherVcs.description: Why a folder can't be made a git repository: another version control system (Jujutsu, Mercurial…), {vcs}, keeps it. {root} is the folder it keeps.

main.gitInit.step.commit.description: A step that worked in making a git repository: a clause in a list of them ("Initialised a git repository on main, added a Node .gitignore and committed 3 files."); Hive capitalises the first of the list. {n} is how many files the first commit has.

main.gitInit.step.empty.description: A step that worked in making a git repository: a clause in a list of them ("Initialised a git repository on main, added a Node .gitignore and committed 3 files."); Hive capitalises the first of the list.

main.gitInit.step.gitignore.description: A step that worked in making a git repository: a clause in a list of them ("Initialised a git repository on main, added a Node .gitignore and committed 3 files."); Hive capitalises the first of the list. {gitignore} names the starter .gitignore (a Node .gitignore).

main.gitInit.step.identity.description: A step that worked in making a git repository: a clause in a list of them ("Initialised a git repository on main, added a Node .gitignore and committed 3 files."); Hive capitalises the first of the list: the name and email the commits are made as.

main.gitInit.step.init.defaultMessage: initialised a git repository on main
main.gitInit.step.init.description: A step that worked in making a git repository: a clause in a list of them ("Initialised a git repository on main, added a Node .gitignore and committed 3 files."); Hive capitalises the first of the list. main is the branch's name: keep it.

main.gitInit.stopped.description: Why making a git repository failed at its first step. {what} is what failed (main.gitInit.failed.*, which starts with a small letter in English), {why} why.

main.gitInit.stoppedAfter.description: Why making a git repository stopped part way. {done} lists the steps that worked (main.gitInit.step.*), {what} what failed (main.gitInit.failed.*), {why} why (git's message, or what to do).

main.gitInit.unreadable.description: Why a folder can't be made a git repository. {why} is git's own message.

main.installDir.close.description: A button of the message window when Hive can't start from its install folder: closes it (Hive then quits).

main.installDir.copied.description: A button of the message window when Hive can't start from its install folder: what Copy Command says once it has copied the command.

main.installDir.copy.description: The last line of Electron's error box when Hive can't start from its install folder. Ctrl+C is a key: keep it.

main.installDir.copyCommand.description: A button of the message window when Hive can't start from its install folder: copies the command to run.

main.installDir.title.description: The title of the message when Hive can't start from its install folder.

main.installDir.whatFile.defaultMessage: Windows won't let Hive's windows read a file in the folder Hive is installed in:
main.installDir.whatFile.description: The message when Hive can't start from its install folder, its first line (the file's path follows on the next).

main.installDir.whatFolder.defaultMessage: Windows won't let Hive's windows read the folder Hive is installed in:
main.installDir.whatFolder.description: The message when Hive can't start from its install folder, its first line (the folder's path follows on the next).

main.installDir.whyFile.defaultMessage: Its permissions have an entry for an app package but none for ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES, which Hive's sandboxed windows need, and Hive couldn't add one. Run this command in PowerShell (as an administrator if you don't own them): it adds the entry to the folder and to the file. Then start Hive again:
main.installDir.whyFile.description: The message when Hive can't start from its install folder, its last paragraph (a command follows). ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES is a Windows name and PowerShell a program: keep them.

main.installDir.whyFolder.defaultMessage: Its permissions have an entry for an app package but none for ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES, which Hive's sandboxed windows need, and Hive couldn't add one. Run this command in PowerShell (as an administrator if you don't own the folder), then start Hive again:
main.installDir.whyFolder.description: The message when Hive can't start from its install folder, its last paragraph (a command follows). ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES is a Windows name and PowerShell a program: keep them.

main.keys.maskingFull.defaultMessage: Hive can't keep masking for another key: it already keeps the most it can. The key wasn't saved.
main.keys.maskingFull.description: An error saving a server connection's API key: Hive keeps a fingerprint of every key ever saved (to hide it in logs and exports) and has reached its limit.

main.keys.maskingUnreadable.defaultMessage: Hive can't check this for API keys: its masking data can't be read. See Settings → Accounts & Connections.
main.keys.maskingUnreadable.description: An error: an export, Copy Diagnostics or a recording was refused because the data Hive uses to hide server connections' API keys can't be read. Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section, where it can be reset.

main.keys.unsafe.defaultMessage: Hive can't store a key safely on this system, so it wasn't saved.
main.keys.unsafe.description: An error saving a server connection's API key (Settings → Accounts & Connections): Windows' protection for stored secrets isn't available, and Hive won't keep a key in plain text.

main.leftovers.end.description: Button: ends the processes the agents left running.

main.leftovers.keep.description: Button: leaves the processes an agent left running.

main.leftovers.leave.description: Button: leaves the processes the agents left running.

main.leftovers.offerChanged.defaultMessage: They changed since this notice: see them in the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane
main.leftovers.offerChanged.description: What the notice of processes an agent left running says once what runs is no longer exactly what it listed (HI-2320): its End Them would end processes it didn't show, so its buttons go. The ⋯ menu on the agent's pane lists them with End and Keep.

main.leftovers.offerEnded.description: What the notice of processes an agent left running says once End Them ended them (HI-2320), in place of its buttons. {n} is how many.

main.leftovers.offerEndedSome.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Ended the # process listed} other {Ended the # processes listed}}; {more, plural, one {# started since still runs: see the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane} other {# started since still run: see the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane}}
main.leftovers.offerEndedSome.description: What the notice of processes an agent left running says after End Them ended exactly the ones it listed while others started since still run (HI-2320), in place of its buttons. {n} and {more} are how many. The ⋯ menu on the agent's pane lists them with End and Keep.

main.leftovers.offerGone.description: What the notice of processes an agent left running says once they ended by themselves, or were ended or kept elsewhere (HI-2320), in place of its buttons.

main.leftovers.offerIncomplete.defaultMessage: Hive couldn't list them all, so it can't end exactly these: see the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane
main.leftovers.offerIncomplete.description: What the notice of processes an agent left running says when End Them is pressed but the notice couldn't list every process (more than it shows, or one without a start time), so Hive won't end them from it (HI-2320). The ⋯ menu on the agent's pane lists them with End and Keep.

main.leftovers.offerKept.description: What the notice of processes an agent left running says once Keep Running was chosen (HI-2320), in place of its buttons.

main.leftovers.offerNotEnded.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Windows didn't let Hive end the process listed. Try again.} other {Windows didn't let Hive end all # processes listed. Try again.}}
main.leftovers.offerNotEnded.description: An error after End Them on the notice of processes an agent left running: some of the processes it listed still run (HI-2320). {n} is how many it listed.

main.leftovers.offerUnchecked.defaultMessage: Hive couldn't check what runs now, so it ended nothing. Try again.
main.leftovers.offerUnchecked.description: An error after End Them or Keep Running on the notice of processes an agent left running: Hive couldn't read what the agent's processes are now, so it did nothing (HI-2320).

main.leftovers.quitDetail.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {The agents started it, and it may hold project folders or ports. End it as Hive quits, or leave it running?} other {The agents started them, and they may hold project folders or ports. End them as Hive quits, or leave them running?}}
main.leftovers.quitDetail.description: The question as Hive quits, under the list of the processes agents left running. {n} is how many.

main.leftovers.quitMessage.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Agents left # process running} other {Agents left # processes running}}
main.leftovers.quitMessage.description: The question as Hive quits: processes the agents started are still running. {n} is how many.

main.leftovers.restoredBody.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{processes}. It was started by the agent before Hive last closed, and may hold the project's folder or ports.} other {{processes}. They were started by the agent before Hive last closed, and may hold the project's folder or ports.}}
main.leftovers.restoredBody.description: The notice at start about processes an agent left running. {processes} lists them ("node serve.js, 2 × tail -f capture.log"); {n} is how many.

main.leftovers.restoredTitle.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{agent} left # process running} other {{agent} left # processes running}}
main.leftovers.restoredTitle.description: A notice at start: processes an agent started before Hive last closed still run. {agent} is the agent (or project) name; {n} how many.

main.mergeSlot.expiredBody.defaultMessage: {agent} held the merge slot for {branch} longer than its limit without reporting progress, so it went to the next in line. Check whether its merge finished.
main.mergeSlot.expiredBody.description: The notice that an agent's merge slot expired. {agent} is the agent, {branch} the branch it was merging into.

main.mergeSlot.expiredTitle.description: A notice's title: an agent ({agent}) held the merge slot longer than its limit without reporting progress, so Hive gave it to the next agent in line.

main.mergeSlot.leftBody.defaultMessage: It held the merge slot for {branch}{hasCards, select, yes { ({cards})} other {}}. Check {folder} for a merge left half done (git status there) before the next merge.
main.mergeSlot.leftBody.description: The notice that an agent was merging when Hive closed: {branch} is the branch it held the slot for, {cards} the cards it named ("#7, #9"; shown when {hasCards} is yes), {folder} where the merge was. 'git status' is a command: keep it.

main.mergeSlot.leftBodyGone.defaultMessage: It held the merge slot for {branch}{hasCards, select, yes { ({cards})} other {}} in {project}, a project this workspace no longer has (its folder is another project's now, or gone). Check {folder} for a merge left half done (git status there) before the next merge.
main.mergeSlot.leftBodyGone.description: The notice that an agent was merging when Hive closed, in a project ({project}, its name) the workspace no longer has: {branch} is the branch it held the slot for, {cards} the cards it named ("#7, #9"; shown when {hasCards} is yes), {folder} where the merge was. 'git status' is a command: keep it.

main.mergeSlot.leftTitle.description: A notice's title as a workspace opens: the agent {agent} (its name) held the merge slot when Hive last closed, so its merge may be half done.

main.modes.retiredBody.defaultMessage: Coordinator, Planner, QA triager and Release manager replace Hive's character personas ({moved}). Switch modes from the Assistant's header; your own personas are unchanged.
main.modes.retiredBody.description: The notice that personas became working modes. The four names are the modes' own names: keep them. {moved} lists which persona became which mode ("Pirate → Coordinator").

main.modes.retiredTitle.defaultMessage: The Assistant's personas are now working modes
main.modes.retiredTitle.description: A notice once, after an update: the Assistant's character personas became working modes.

main.move.adoptFailed.defaultMessage: The handovers and kept comparisons saved under a project's earlier name couldn't all be given to it ({why}). Repair tries again.
main.move.adoptFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {why} is the system's message. Kept comparisons are benchmarks kept in Performance → Compare.

main.move.already.defaultMessage: A repair is already running in this window.
main.move.already.description: An error: Repair (after a workspace moved) was asked for twice.

main.move.alsoMoved.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{things} of {from} now is {to}'s.} other {{things} of {from} now are {to}'s.}}
main.move.alsoMoved.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner): what was left under a project's old name went to the project. {from} is the old name, {to} the project. {things} lists the lanes and card watches (main.move.lanes, main.move.watches); {n} is how many in all.

main.move.assistant.description: The Hive Assistant's name, where Repair (after a workspace moved) lists what it repairs and the agents still running.

main.move.branchBoth.description: Why Repair couldn't rename an agent's branch (in main.move.branchFailed's {why}): a branch with the new name appeared meanwhile.

main.move.branchFailed.defaultMessage: {host}: branch {from} of agent {agent} couldn't be renamed to {to} ({why}).
main.move.branchFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder. {host} is the project; {agent} an agent; {from} and {to} are branch names; {why} is git's or the system's message. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

main.move.branchGone.defaultMessage: {host}: branch {from} of agent {agent} is gone, so it isn't renamed.
main.move.branchGone.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder: an agent's branch to rename no longer exists. {host} is the project; {agent} an agent; {from} a branch name. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

main.move.branchQueued.defaultMessage: a queued step still uses it; Repair renames it next time
main.move.branchQueued.description: Why Repair couldn't rename an agent's branch yet (in main.move.branchFailed's {why}): one of the board's queued steps (preparing a card's folder) names the branch.

main.move.branchRenamed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder: an agent's branch named after the old place was renamed, with Hive's record of it. {host} is the project; {agent} an agent; {from} and {to} are branch names. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

main.move.branchRenamedRemote.defaultMessage: {host}: branch {from} of agent {agent} is now {to}; it still tracks {from} on remote {remote}, so push it under the new name when you're ready.
main.move.branchRenamedRemote.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder: an agent's branch named after the old place was renamed, and it tracks a remote, which keeps the old name. {host} is the project; {agent} an agent; {from} and {to} are branch names; {remote} the remote (origin). A noun before each name (glossary §1 rule 4).

main.move.branchTaken.defaultMessage: {host}: branch {from} of agent {agent} keeps its name: {to} is already a branch.
main.move.branchTaken.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder: an agent's branch named after the old place isn't renamed, because a branch with its new name exists. {host} is the project; {agent} an agent; {from} and {to} are branch names. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

main.move.branchUnrecorded.defaultMessage: {host}: the branch of agent {agent} is now {to}, but Hive couldn't record it yet ({why}). Repair finishes it.
main.move.branchUnrecorded.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder: git renamed an agent's branch, and Hive's record of it (or of the cards on it) couldn't be written; the next Repair finishes it. {host} is the project; {agent} an agent; {to} the branch's new name; {why} the system's message. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

main.move.cards.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# card of {from} now belongs to {to}, with its agents.} other {# cards of {from} now belong to {to}, with their agents.}}
main.move.cards.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner): what was left under a project's old name went to the project. {from} is the old name, {to} the project. {n} is how many cards.

main.move.cardsNotMoved.defaultMessage: {host}: the cards {agent} works on couldn't be told its worktree is now at {path} ({why}). Repair tries again.
main.move.cardsNotMoved.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder: the board's record of the cards worked on in an agent's worktree couldn't be updated to its new place. {host} is the project; {agent} an agent; {path} the worktree's new folder; {why} the system's message.

main.move.closeRunsFailed.defaultMessage: Hive's records of the workspace's close command couldn't all follow it from the old folder ({why}). Hive tries again.
main.move.closeRunsFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace moved to another folder: the output Hive keeps of the workspace's close command couldn't all be moved from the old folder's records. {why} is the system's message.

main.move.copied.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{owner, select, project {{host}: copied {n, number} file of {provider}'s conversations and memory for the project to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).} assistant {{host}: copied {n, number} file of {provider}'s conversations and memory for the Assistant to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).} worktree {{host}: copied {n, number} file of {provider}'s conversations and memory for {agent}'s worktree to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).} other {{host}: copied {n, number} file of {provider}'s conversations and memory for {of} to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).}}} other {{owner, select, project {{host}: copied {n, number} files of {provider}'s conversations and memory for the project to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).} assistant {{host}: copied {n, number} files of {provider}'s conversations and memory for the Assistant to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).} worktree {{host}: copied {n, number} files of {provider}'s conversations and memory for {agent}'s worktree to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).} other {{host}: copied {n, number} files of {provider}'s conversations and memory for {of} to its folder for the new path (the old folder is kept).}}}}
main.move.copied.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {n} is how many files; {provider} is the coding agent (Claude Code); {owner} whose folder the files are for: the project, the Assistant, an agent's worktree ({agent} is the agent), or other (a name kept from an older record, {of}).

main.move.copyFailed.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{owner, select, project {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for the project couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.} assistant {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for the Assistant couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.} worktree {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for {agent}'s worktree couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.} other {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for {of} couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.}}} other {{owner, select, project {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for the project couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.} assistant {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for the Assistant couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.} worktree {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for {agent}'s worktree couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.} other {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for {of} couldn't be copied to {folder}: {files}. Repair tries them again.}}}}
main.move.copyFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {n} is how many files; {provider} is the coding agent (Claude Code); {owner} whose folder the files are for: the project, the Assistant, an agent's worktree ({agent} is the agent), or other (a name kept from an older record, {of}); {folder} is where they would go; {files} lists them.

main.move.copyKept.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{owner, select, project {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for the project already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.} assistant {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for the Assistant already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.} worktree {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for {agent}'s worktree already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.} other {{host}: {n, number} file of {provider}'s for {of} already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.}}} other {{owner, select, project {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for the project already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.} assistant {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for the Assistant already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.} worktree {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for {agent}'s worktree already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.} other {{host}: {n, number} files of {provider}'s for {of} already in {folder} with other content, not overwritten: {files}.}}}}
main.move.copyKept.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {n} is how many files; {provider} is the coding agent (Claude Code); {owner} whose folder the files are for: the project, the Assistant, an agent's worktree ({agent} is the agent), or other (a name kept from an older record, {of}); {folder} is where they would go; {files} lists them.

main.move.defenderFailed.defaultMessage: Hive's Defender exclusions couldn't be moved to the new folders ({why}).
main.move.defenderFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace moved to another folder: moving Hive's Microsoft Defender exclusions from the old folders to the new ones failed. {why} is the system's message.

main.move.folder.busy.description: Why Repair couldn't update its record of a slot or copy (in main.move.folder.failed's {why}): one of Hive's own steps (setting it up, removing it) holds it now. A clause.

main.move.folder.failed.defaultMessage: {host}: {what} at {path} couldn't be recorded ({why}). Repair tries again.
main.move.folder.failed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved: one of the project's slots, copies or old reviewer folders ({what}: its name) was found at {path}, but Hive's record of it couldn't be updated ({why}). {host} is the project.

main.move.folder.forgotten.defaultMessage: {host}: {what} is no longer kept (it was at {path}); its conversations can't be resumed there.
main.move.folder.forgotten.description: A line of Repair's report: an old reviewer folder ({what}) that wasn't found is forgotten, as the user chose; the conversations that ran there can be read, not resumed there. {host} is the project, {path} where it was.

main.move.folder.homeMissing.defaultMessage: {host}: {what} wasn't found (it was at {path}). Locate it, or forget it.
main.move.folder.homeMissing.description: A line of Repair's report: an old reviewer folder ({what}), where its conversations resume, wasn't found; Repair waits for the user's choice. {host} is the project, {path} where it was.

main.move.folder.later.defaultMessage: {host}: {what} wasn't found; it's made again at {path} when it is next used.
main.move.folder.later.description: A line of Repair's report: a free slot or a review copy ({what}: its name) whose folder wasn't found; Hive makes it again at {path} the next time it lends it. {host} is the project.

main.move.folder.movedTo.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved: one of the project's slots, copies or old reviewer folders ({what}: its name) is now at {path}. {host} is the project.

main.move.folder.original.defaultMessage: {host}: {what} at {path} stays linked to the project at {project}, which is still there.
main.move.folder.original.description: A line of Repair's report: one of the project's slots, copies or old reviewer folders ({what}) stays with the project folder it was made from ({project}), which is still there (a copy was moved). {host} is the project, {path} the folder.

main.move.folder.recreateFailed.description: A line of Repair's report: a lent slot whose folder was gone couldn't be made again ({why}: the reason, often in English from git). {what} is its name, {host} the project.

main.move.folder.recreated.description: A line of Repair's report: a slot lent to an agent, whose folder was gone, was made again on its branch ({branch}) at {path}; the agent keeps it. {what} is its name, {host} the project.

main.move.folder.released.defaultMessage: {host}: {what} was released; it's made again where it belongs when it is next lent.
main.move.folder.released.description: A line of Repair's report: a lent slot whose folder was gone was released (its agent no longer has it); Hive makes it again at its next use. {what} is its name, {host} the project.

main.move.folder.relinked.defaultMessage: {host}: {what} at {path} is linked to the project again.
main.move.folder.relinked.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved: one of the project's slots, review copies or old reviewer folders ({what}: its name, such as "slot-b (HI-B1, AM-12)") is linked to the project again. {host} is the project, {path} the folder.

main.move.folder.slotMissing.defaultMessage: {hasBranch, select, yes {{host}: {what} wasn't found (it was at {path}). Recreate it on {branch}, locate it, or release it.} other {{host}: {what} wasn't found (it was at {path}), and its branch is gone too. Locate it, or release it.}}
main.move.folder.slotMissing.description: A line of Repair's report: a lent slot ({what}: its name) wasn't found; Repair waits for the user's choice: make it again on its branch ({branch}), pick its folder, or release it. {host} is the project, {path} where it was.

main.move.gitFailed.description: Why git couldn't do something, when it said nothing itself. {command} is the git command: keep it.

main.move.lanes.description: Card loops (lanes) that went to a project, in a list (main.move.alsoMoved). {n} is how many.

main.move.madeNew.defaultMessage: {host}: {agent}'s worktree was made new on {branch} (its branch was gone), at {path}.
main.move.madeNew.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {branch} is the new branch, {path} the new worktree.

main.move.makeNewFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {why} says why.

main.move.missing.defaultMessage: {host}: {agent}'s worktree wasn't found (it was at {path}). Recreate it on its branch, locate it, or remove the agent's worktree link.
main.move.missing.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is where it was. Its branch is still there.

main.move.missingNoBranch.defaultMessage: {host}: {agent}'s worktree wasn't found (it was at {path}). Create a new worktree, locate it, or remove the agent's worktree link.
main.move.missingNoBranch.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is where it was. Its branch has gone too.

main.move.more.description: The last item of a long list in Repair's report (after a workspace moved), after the first few: how many more there are (folders, files or names). Hive joins it to the list ("A, B, C and 3 more").

main.move.movedTo.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is where the worktree is now.

main.move.notRepaired.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is the worktree.

main.move.notRepairedWhy.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is the worktree, {why} git's message.

main.move.nothing.defaultMessage: Nothing to repair: everything already points to where the workspace is now.
main.move.nothing.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner): there was nothing to do.

main.move.original.defaultMessage: {host}: {agent}'s worktree at {path} stays linked to the project at {project}, which is still there.
main.move.original.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is the worktree, {project} the project folder it was made from (a copy was moved, not that one).

main.move.recent.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). Open Recent is a menu (File → Open Recent): use its name as shown. {to} is the workspace folder now, {from} where it was.

main.move.recreateFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {why} says why.

main.move.recreated.defaultMessage: {host}: {agent}'s worktree was recreated on its branch {branch}, at {path}.
main.move.recreated.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {branch} is its branch, {path} the new worktree.

main.move.relinked.defaultMessage: {host}: {agent}'s worktree at {path} is linked to the project again.
main.move.relinked.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is the worktree.

main.move.result.agentWorktree.description: Repair's report: an agent's worktree ({agent}: its name), in a list of worktrees in the way (main.move.result.pruneBlocked's {worktrees}).

main.move.result.cards.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# card, with its agents} other {# cards, with their agents}}
main.move.result.cards.description: Repair's report: cards that went to a project, in a list (main.move.result.given's {what}). {n} is how many.

main.move.result.copied.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# file copied} other {# files copied}}
main.move.result.copied.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a coding agent's conversation and memory files copied to the new folder ({n}: how many).

main.move.result.copyFailed.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# file couldn't be copied} other {# files couldn't be copied}}
main.move.result.copyFailed.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a coding agent's files that couldn't be copied (the row's tooltip lists them); Repair tries them again.

main.move.result.copyKept.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# file already there with other content, kept} other {# files already there with other content, kept}}
main.move.result.copyKept.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a coding agent's files already in the new folder with other content, never overwritten (the row's tooltip lists them).

main.move.result.failed.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a step failed ({why}: the system's message); the next Repair tries again.

main.move.result.folderMissing.defaultMessage: {kind, select, home {not found: locate or forget it} other {{gone, select, yes {not found, its branch gone too: locate or release it} other {not found: recreate, locate or release it}}}}
main.move.result.folderMissing.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a lent slot or an old reviewer folder ({kind}: slot or home) wasn't found; Repair waits for the user's choice (#1447).

main.move.result.forgotten.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an old reviewer folder that wasn't found is forgotten (#1447).

main.move.result.given.description: Repair's report, the Result column of a board row: what was saved under a project's old name went to the project ({to}); {what} lists it ("9 cards, 1 lane").

main.move.result.gone.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's branch to rename no longer exists.

main.move.result.later.defaultMessage: made again here when next used
main.move.result.later.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a free slot or review copy wasn't found, and is made again at its new place when next used (#1447).

main.move.result.linked.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's worktree is linked to the moved project again (git worktree repair).

main.move.result.missing.defaultMessage: {gone, select, yes {not found, its branch gone too: create, locate or remove its link} other {not found: recreate, locate or remove its link}}
main.move.result.missing.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's worktree wasn't found; Repair waits for the user's choice (Repair's buttons).

main.move.result.notGiven.description: Repair's report, the Result column: what was saved under an old name couldn't all go to its project ({to}: the project, or none known; {why}: the system's message). Repair tries again.

main.move.result.notRepaired.defaultMessage: couldn't be repaired{hasWhy, select, yes {: {why}} other {}}
main.move.result.notRepaired.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's worktree couldn't be linked again; {why} is git's message.

main.move.result.original.defaultMessage: stays linked to the project at its old folder
main.move.result.original.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a worktree stays with the project folder it was made from, which is still there (a copy was moved).

main.move.result.pruneBlocked.defaultMessage: couldn't be recreated while {n, plural, one {another worktree is missing too ({worktrees}): locate, recreate or remove it first} other {# other worktrees are missing too ({worktrees}): locate, recreate or remove them first}}
main.move.result.pruneBlocked.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a missing worktree can't be made again yet, because git's clean-up would also forget other missing worktrees. {worktrees} lists them (an agent's worktree, main.move.result.agentWorktree, or a folder's name); {n}: how many. The row's tooltip says it in full.

main.move.result.recent.description: Repair's report, the Result column of Open Recent: the new folder replaces the old one.

main.move.result.recreateFailed.defaultMessage: {made, select, new {couldn't be made new: {why}} other {couldn't be recreated: {why}}}
main.move.result.recreateFailed.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's worktree couldn't be made again ({why}: the reason).

main.move.result.recreated.defaultMessage: {made, select, new {made new (its branch was gone)} other {recreated on its branch}}
main.move.result.recreated.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's worktree made again on its branch, or new when its branch was gone. The branch's name is in the agent's branch row (Repair may rename it in the same run).

main.move.result.released.defaultMessage: released; made again when next lent
main.move.result.released.description: Repair's report, the Result column: a lent slot whose folder was gone was released, and is made again at its next use (#1447).

main.move.result.renameFailed.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's branch couldn't be renamed ({why}: git's or the system's message).

main.move.result.renamed.defaultMessage: {remote, select, none {renamed} other {renamed; it still tracks {remote}'s old name}}
main.move.result.renamed.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's branch was renamed; {remote} is the remote it tracks (origin), which keeps the old name, or none.

main.move.result.sessions.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# session points here now} other {# sessions point here now}}
main.move.result.sessions.description: Repair's report, the Result column: session records pointed to the new folder ({n}: how many).

main.move.result.taken.defaultMessage: kept: the new name is a branch already
main.move.result.taken.description: Repair's report, the Result column: an agent's branch isn't renamed, because a branch with the new name exists.

main.move.result.unlinked.defaultMessage: link removed; its folder was left as it was
main.move.result.unlinked.description: Repair's report, the Result column: the agent no longer has a worktree; the folder, if any, is untouched.

main.move.result.unrecorded.defaultMessage: renamed, but not recorded yet ({why}): Repair finishes it
main.move.result.unrecorded.description: Repair's report, the Result column: git renamed an agent's branch, but Hive couldn't record it yet ({why}: the system's message).

main.move.result.working.description: Repair's report, the Result column of Working on: the projects ({projects}) are marked Working on again.

main.move.running.description: Why Repair (after a workspace moved) can't start: agents are running. {agents} lists them (project · agent).

main.move.savedFailed.defaultMessage: What was saved under {from} couldn't all be given to {to} ({why}). Repair tries again.
main.move.savedFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {from} is a project's old name, {to} the project, {why} the system's message.

main.move.sessions.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{host}: # session now points to the new folder.} other {{host}: # sessions now point to the new folder.}}
main.move.sessions.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {n} is how many sessions.

main.move.sessionsFailed.defaultMessage: {host}: the sessions' folders couldn't be updated ({why}). Repair tries again.
main.move.sessionsFailed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {why} is the system's message.

main.move.unlinked.defaultMessage: {host}: {agent} no longer has a worktree (its folder {path} was left as it was).
main.move.unlinked.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner). {host} is the project (or the Assistant) it is about; {agent} an agent. {path} is the old worktree.

main.move.watches.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# card watch} other {# card watches}}
main.move.watches.description: Agents' card watches that went to a project, in a list (main.move.alsoMoved). {n} is how many.

main.move.workingMoved.defaultMessage: Working on: {projects}, as before the move.
main.move.workingMoved.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner): the projects stay Working on. Working on is how the sidebar marks projects: use its name as shown. {projects} lists them.

main.move.workingRenamed.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Working on: {projects}, as before its rename.} other {Working on: {projects}, as before their rename.}}
main.move.workingRenamed.description: A line of Repair's report, after a workspace or project moved to another folder (the moved-workspace banner): renamed projects stay Working on. Working on is how the sidebar marks projects: use its name as shown. {projects} lists them; {n} is how many.

main.notify.answered.description: What a notification that an agent waited for you (or asked you something) says once it no longer does (HI-2320): answered, or it moved on. Shown under its title, in the pop-up and the bell's list. Keep it short.

main.notify.sessionEnded.description: What a notification that an agent waited for you says once its session has ended (HI-2320), so it no longer waits. Shown under its title, in the pop-up and the bell's list. Keep it short.

main.outage.gaveUpBody.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {It was resumed once in the past hour} other {It was resumed # times in the past hour}} and stopped again, so Hive won't resume it again by itself. This PC's network may not have recovered: try renewing its network adapter's addresses (ipconfig /renew), flushing DNS (ipconfig /flushdns) or restarting the PC, then resume it.
main.outage.gaveUpBody.description: The notice that Hive stopped resuming an agent whose connection kept dropping. {n} is how many times it was resumed in the past hour. ipconfig /renew and ipconfig /flushdns are Windows commands: keep them.

main.outage.gaveUpTitle.description: A notice's title: an agent's connection dropped again after Hive had resumed it several times in an hour, so Hive stopped resuming it. {agent} is the agent's name.

main.outage.progressTitle.description: A Progress panel run's title while Hive waits for an agent's connection to come back, to resume it. {agent} is the agent's name.

main.outage.progressWaiting.description: What a Progress panel run waits for, after "Waiting for": the connection of an agent whose turn a dropped connection ended.

main.outage.resumedSummary.defaultMessage: Resumed: the connection dropped at {dropped} and came back at {back}.
main.outage.resumedSummary.description: A Progress panel run's summary: Hive resumed an agent once its connection came back. {dropped} and {back} are times of day.

main.outage.timedOutBody.defaultMessage: Hive waited {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and stopped waiting. If other apps can reach the internet, this PC's network may not have recovered: try renewing its network adapter's addresses (ipconfig /renew), flushing DNS (ipconfig /flushdns) or restarting the PC, then resume it.
main.outage.timedOutBody.description: The notice that Hive stopped waiting for an agent's connection. {minutes} is how long it waited. ipconfig /renew and ipconfig /flushdns are Windows commands: keep them.

main.outage.timedOutTitle.description: A notice's title: Hive waited for an agent's connection to come back, to resume it, and gave up. {agent} is the agent's name.

main.outcome.allowed.description: What the notice that an agent wants to edit a file another agent is editing says after Allow (HI-2320), in place of its button. Keep it short.

main.outcome.conversationEnded.description: What a notification about an agent's conversation (a long conversation's Hand Over to…) says once that conversation's session has ended (HI-2320), in place of its button.

main.outcome.conversationMoved.defaultMessage: It has a new conversation now
main.outcome.conversationMoved.description: What the long-conversation notification says once the agent has moved to a new conversation (handed over, or the CLI started one; HI-2320), in place of its Hand Over to… button.

main.outcome.modesChanged.description: What the notice that the permission mode changed says once the setting changed again since it was shown, so its Switch Now no longer names the mode the settings say (HI-2320), in place of its button.

main.outcome.modesNextSession.defaultMessage: Their sessions ended: the new mode applies from the next
main.outcome.modesNextSession.description: What the notice that the permission mode changed says once none of the agents it named still runs that session (HI-2320), in place of its Switch Now button.

main.outcome.modesNothing.defaultMessage: Nothing to switch: every running agent is in its mode
main.outcome.modesNothing.description: What the notice that the permission mode changed says after Switch Now found nothing to switch (HI-2320), in place of its button.

main.outcome.namesDiffer.description: What the notice that agents share a name says once they no longer do (HI-2320), in place of its Rename… button.

main.outcome.noLongerAsked.description: What the notice that an agent wants to edit a locked file says once the agent no longer asks (its edit went ahead, its session ended, or it was allowed elsewhere; HI-2320, HI-2386), in place of its Allow button.

main.outcome.noLongerHeld.description: What the notice that a slot is held by Windows' idle Sandbox broker says once nothing holds it (HI-2320), in place of its Release Slot… button.

main.outcome.notResumed.description: What the notice offering to resume the agents that were working before Hive restarted says after Don't Resume (HI-2320), in place of its buttons.

main.outcome.offerReplaced.description: What the notice offering to resume the agents that were working before Hive restarted says once a newer such notice replaces it, listing every agent offered (another workspace got ready later; HI-2356), in place of its buttons.

main.outcome.openHereAgain.defaultMessage: The conversation is open here again
main.outcome.openHereAgain.description: What the notice that a conversation runs as a background job says once it is open in Hive again (HI-2320), in place of its Stop It and Resume button.

main.outcome.released.description: What the notice that a slot is held by Windows' idle Sandbox broker says once the slot is released (HI-2320), in place of its Release Slot… button. Keep it short.

main.outcome.resuming.description: What the notice offering to resume the agents that were working before Hive restarted says after Resume, in place of its buttons, until it says how the resumes went (HI-2356).

main.outcome.runsAnother.defaultMessage: It runs another conversation here now
main.outcome.runsAnother.description: What the notice that a conversation runs as a background job says once the agent runs another conversation in Hive (HI-2320), in place of its Stop It and Resume button.

main.outcome.stoppedAndResumed.description: What the notice that a conversation runs as a background job says after Stop It and Resume (HI-2320), in place of its button.

main.outcome.updateInstalling.description: What the notice that a Hive update is ready says after Restart and Update (HI-2320), in place of its button, as Hive restarts to install it.

main.outcome.updateNotReady.description: What the notice that a Hive update is ready says once that update is no longer the one ready (HI-2320), in place of its Restart and Update button.

main.plan.close.defaultMessage: You are getting close to the limit.

main.plan.pause.defaultMessage: Sessions will pause when it runs out.
main.plan.pause.description: A plan-usage notice, at 95% used or more.

main.plan.resetsAt.description: The end of a plan-usage notice: the limit resets today. {time} is the time.

main.plan.resetsOn.description: The end of a plan-usage notice: the limit resets another day. {when} is the day and time.

main.plan.used.defaultMessage: {share, number, ::percent} of your {provider} {window, select, hours {{hours, plural, one {#-hour limit} other {#-hour limit}}} weekly {weekly limit} other {{label} limit}} used
main.plan.used.description: A notice: how much of a plan's usage limit is used ({share}: "85%"). {provider} is the coding agent. The limit is a rolling window of {hours} hours (the 5-hour one), the weekly one, or another the provider names itself ({label}, in English as the provider says it).

main.plan.usedOn.defaultMessage: {share, number, ::percent} of the {window, select, hours {{hours, plural, one {#-hour limit} other {#-hour limit}}} weekly {weekly limit} other {{label} limit}} used on {connection}
main.plan.usedOn.description: A notice (HI-1756): how much of a plan's usage limit is used ({share}: "85%") on one connection, a sign-in the user named ({connection}: "Max 1"). The limit is a rolling window of {hours} hours (the 5-hour one), the weekly one, or another the provider names itself ({label}, in English as the provider says it).

main.profileMove.fallbackBody.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {The Combwork folder isn't there, so Hive runs from {folders}, as before.} other {The Combwork folders aren't there, so Hive runs from {folders}, as before.}} Installing Combwork with Hive closed moves {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}; nothing is lost meanwhile.
main.profileMove.fallbackBody.description: The notice that Hive uses its old data folders. {folders} lists their paths; {n} is how many (1 or 2). "Installing Combwork": running the installer of the app under its new name.

main.profileMove.fallbackBodyDev.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {The {name} folder isn't there, so this dev build runs from {folders}.} other {The {name} folders aren't there, so this dev build runs from {folders}.}} To move {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}, close Hive and rename {n, plural, one {it} other {each}} to {name}.
main.profileMove.fallbackBodyDev.description: The same notice for a development build of Hive (no installer moves its folders). {name} is the new folder name (Combwork-Dev: keep it as it is); {folders} lists the old folders' paths; {n} is how many (1 or 2).

main.profileMove.fallbackTitle.defaultMessage: Hive is using its data folders from before Combwork
main.profileMove.fallbackTitle.description: A notice at start (HI-2461): the app's data folders are now named Combwork (the app's new name, keep it as it is), which the installer moves them to; they weren't moved yet, so Hive uses its old folders. Nothing is lost.

main.profileMove.signInBody.defaultMessage: Since Hive moved its data to the Combwork folder, {names} {n, plural, one {shows} other {show}} signed out. Sign in again in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
main.profileMove.signInBody.description: The notice naming the connections that show signed out after the data moved. {names} lists them by name; {n} is how many.

main.profileMove.signInTitle.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Sign in to # connection again} other {Sign in to # connections again}}
main.profileMove.signInTitle.description: A notice at start (HI-2461), once: after the app's data moved to the Combwork folder (the app's new name), some connections' sign-ins didn't carry across. {n} is how many.

main.quit.closed.description: A notice after Hive quit without asking, its sessions stopped.

main.quit.closedBody.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# session was stopped. Resume it from Hive next time; nothing was lost.} other {# sessions were stopped. Resume them from Hive next time; nothing was lost.}}
main.quit.closedBody.description: The notice after Hive quit: how many sessions it stopped.

main.quit.dialogTitle.description: The title of the question, as Hive quits, about the processes agents left running.

main.removal.ahead.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# commit not merged} other {# commits not merged}}
main.removal.ahead.description: Work in an agent's worktree that stops Remove from Hive: its commits not merged. {n} is how many.

main.removal.already.description: An error: the project is being removed, hidden or deleted already.

main.removal.cardsKept.defaultMessage: Its cards couldn't all be deleted: {why}
main.removal.cardsKept.description: A warning after Delete: some of the project's cards stayed. {why} is the system's message.

main.removal.deleteBlocked.defaultMessage: Delete can't go ahead: {folders}. Nothing was deleted.
main.removal.deleteBlocked.description: Why Delete refused (#1447): the project's slots or old folders that stop it ({folders}: each one's name and why, a list). Nothing was changed.

main.removal.dirty.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
main.removal.dirty.description: Work in an agent's worktree that stops Remove from Hive: its files not committed. {n} is how many.

main.removal.folder.copyBusy.defaultMessage: Hive is setting it up or removing it now
main.removal.folder.copyBusy.description: Remove Project (#1447): a review copy is kept because one of Hive's steps holds it. A clause.

main.removal.folder.copyHeld.description: Remove Project (#1447): a review copy is kept because something runs in it ({by}: what, in English). A clause.

main.removal.folder.copyLeased.description: Remove Project (#1447): a review copy is kept because a review or check uses it. A clause.

main.removal.folder.deleting.defaultMessage: another Delete of this project holds its slots
main.removal.folder.deleting.description: Why Delete can't go ahead (#1447): another Hive window or process is deleting the same project now. A clause.

main.removal.folder.heldNow.defaultMessage: one of Hive's steps or a session took it up meanwhile
main.removal.folder.heldNow.description: Why Delete can't go ahead (#1447): between the dialog's check and Delete's start, one of the project's slots or copies was taken up (set up, renamed, a session started in it, a review copy leased), or a new one made. A clause.

main.removal.folder.home.defaultMessage: left as it is: its conversations resume there
